project_metadata.description: Synthesized Domain Model from Bounded Context analyses for an E-Commerce system, resolving duplicates and defining dependencies.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages customer profiles, their personal information, loyalty programs, and wish lists.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: A person or entity who registers and interacts with the system, making purchases and managing their profile.

entities.name: Wishlist
entities.description: A collection of desired products saved by a customer for future consideration or purchase.

value_objects.name: Address
value_objects.description: A value object representing a physical location for shipping or billing purposes.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages all product information, categories, specifications, and pricing details.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: An item available for sale, uniquely identified by its SKU, with detailed descriptions and images.

entities.name: Category
entities.description: A hierarchical grouping mechanism for products, used to organize and classify items.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles the creation, processing, and lifecycle of customer orders, including order items and status tracking.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A confirmed request by a customer for one or more products, identified by a unique order number.

entities.name: OrderItem
entities.description: A specific line item within an order, detailing the product, quantity, and unit price for that item.

value_objects.name: OrderStatus
value_objects.description: The current state or progress of an order within its lifecycle (e.g., pending, shipped, cancelled).

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: A value object representing a monetary amount along with its associated currency.

bounded_contexts.description: Monitors and updates the stock levels for all products, preventing overselling and managing reservations.

entities.name: StockLevel
entities.description: The current quantity, reserved quantity, and reorder threshold for a specific product in inventory.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles all financial transactions related to orders, including payment capture, refunds, and payment method details.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: A record of a monetary transaction associated with an order, detailing the amount, method, and status.

entities.name: PaymentMethodInfo
entities.description: Details pertaining to the payment instrument used (e.g., credit card type, masked details).

value_objects.name: PaymentStatus
value_objects.description: The current state of a payment transaction (e.g., pending, authorized, captured, failed).
